notes.title: Permanent Price Reduction Incoming
notes.content: [p]After careful consideration, looking at the world and all the price hikes everywhere, we decided that perhaps it would be nice if games were a little less expensive. [/p][p][/p][p]So since today marks the 2nd anniversary we have one announcement to make: Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder will see its normal price reduced permanently to $7.99, or the adjusted equivalent in your country of purchase.[/p][p][/p][p]We would like to thank everyone who purchased and played the game during the last couple of years.[/p][p][/p][p]Oh, and we're also working on the German version of the game, more on that in a few months![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DEMO BUTTON NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Thanks to the report from a diligent community user, we've been made aware that the demo could not be downloaded from the store page even though you could find it if you'd search for it. 
Turns out there was a small "detail" that had been forgotten on my end when I made the demo - a small checkbox in the special settings on the main store page. Not a mistake I'd make again.
Apologies to everyone who was puzzled about not finding this free demo and many, many thanks again to the person who told me, and double-checked it too.

notes.title: 30% Discount on Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder
notes.content: We're celebrating the release of the awesome soundtrack and the free demo for Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder with the first discount! 30% off! And if that's not enough to convince you to take the plunge, there's a free demo you can try out and then decide!

notes.title: Game Demo OUT NOW!
notes.content:
So here it is, we made a demo for our scifi visual novel, Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder.

[list]
[*] The demo takes about 45 minutes to complete and takes place at the beginning of the story.
[*] Game saves have been deactivated, but all other features are there.
[*] All unlocked achievements cross over to the full game!
[*] Demo is available in French and English!
[/list]
Try it out, and if you like it know that the game is on a week long sale from 13th to 20th October 2023!

notes.title: Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder Soundtrack OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Today we celebrate the release of the Extended Soundtrack for Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252038/7dcc593c3afa93da8ceaef5e55bcf10e1aac1fab.png[/img]

25 tracks crafted with love and passion by non other than the great Jonathan van den Wijngaarden, aka Sekond Prime. The incredible Lara Ausensi  performed vocals and additional music. Check out her rendition of Tosca's Te Deum (originally written for Baritone, rearranged here for Soprano), it's fantastic.
The legendary Frank Klepacki also did some additional vocals for us on "Rajnish Grudge"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252038/d83384284aa314548591aa403ab9c9e5744df1cb.png[/img]

Also included is Primo the Alien's Begining of Us that was written specifically for Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder and had been made available since January when the game was announced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252038/fdca89c18ecefd19c4b634f60a9519d789592122.png[/img]

The MP3 files are available in 48000 Hz, 320 kbps compressed stereo, should be great for anything portable. Additional Flac files are available in 24 bit, 96000 Hz high resolution stereo. These are fantastic to listen on dedicated devices but are also a bit heavy at 1.4GB.

We hope you enjoy listening to it as much as we loved making it.

notes.content:
Hi there!

[list]

notes.title: Soundtrack Cover Reveal & Demo Status Update
notes.content:
We're happy to reveal the final OST cover, including the back cover with the final track listing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252038/7dcc593c3afa93da8ceaef5e55bcf10e1aac1fab.png[/img]

The OST will include many extended tracks versus their in-game counterparts, and are off to mastering today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252038/d83384284aa314548591aa403ab9c9e5744df1cb.png[/img]

We initially said the demo and the soundtrack would release in September 2023. That unfortunately won't be possible as the soundtrack needed a bit more time. 

We're aiming for mid October for both, we'll be able to confirm this later. The soundtrack page should be live soon and  In the meantime you can listen to small bits of it here:

[previewyoutube=rfkCRyxY_2g;full][/previewyoutube] 

or here:

[previewyoutube=SbABBcP_SkE;full][/previewyoutube]

There's more on our YouTube channel, don't hesitate to browse all videos!

In other news regarding the demo, saving will be disabled. This is mainly due to a technical problem that prevents the demo saves and the final game from working correctly together. As there is not elegant solution at hand and our resources are limited, the decision was made to remove the save feature from the demo altogether. Should you find yourself in need of stopping midway, know that the skip feature still works, and that all seen text can be skipped. Obviously the rollback feature also still works fine.
In a more positive light, the demo is about 45 minutes long and contains a handful of choices already. All progress that triggers achievements will be transfered to the full game, so there's that.
See you soon!

notes.title: Game Soundtrack & Free Game Demo Coming September 2023!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252038/91e89eab044116bf8ec914bd300712337d61fb06.jpg[/img]

A free demo for Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder will be made available this month (September 2023), it should contain around one hour of gameplay, starting with the beginning. The game is about 12-ish hours long for a first run, so this should give players a decent idea of what the game is about.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44252038/3e0e4031a1a1d30ea9810da6fbe1af69a1ba6f41.jpg[/img]

Coming at the same time is the complete soundtrack! We're very proud and happy to be able to provide all the tracks in an arranged format for listening, containing some changes in comparison to the music found in the game. The full set and track names are going to be revealed at a later time, including other details. 
The music is a labor of love by Jonathan van den Wijngaarden, aka Sekond Prime, who's also recently announced the scores for the 7th Guest Remake for VR, as well as Arizona Sunshine 2. Included in the soundtrack will be the ending song, Beginning of Us, by Primo the Alien.

In addition to Steam, the soundtrack will be made available via the usual streaming and purchase platforms.

notes.title: Steam VISUAL NOVEL Fest
notes.content:
We're happy to let you know that Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder will be participating in the Steam Visual Novel Fest. This means that it will get hopefully a lot more visibility, which will ensure that we can continue to work on it a bit longer and release it in as many languages as possible. And later make more games to continue the story of Galanos, RoKo, Oli, Chrys & Co.

But what does it mean for you?
Well as the game just released we're not doing a discount yet, but we'll be doing giveaways during the entire festival via [url=https://twitter.com/CassiopeiaDev]Twitter[/url]. 

Check out our feed next week!
And as per usual, tell us your favourite moments from the game in the community comments!

notes.title: Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
It's finally that time, Sym.BIOS: Torn Asunder will be in the hands of the players after 2 years of development. We sincerely hope you like what we cooked up. An intriguing story of characters and how their lives become intertwined in a future 300 years from now. We'd love you to leave your thoughts in the comments section or in the reviews!
